lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Good afternoon, am I speaking with Dr. Menon?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Doctor, I am calling from the Mumbai police headquarters regarding a complaint involving your mobile number.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Someone used your SIM in a financial fraud of eleven crore rupees. We need to record your statement.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Please go to a private room. Nobody else should be present during the statement, it is a sealed inquiry.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Okay sir, I am alone now.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Good. Now the judge needs proof your earnings are legal. I will share an account number, transfer your fixed deposits there.
